Capture issue, pull-request, review, and CI work in repository-local operational artifacts while preserving source provenance and project conventions. Use when `.local/arcantry.json` selects `local` as the operational source or when the user asks to normalize repository work into private local state.

## Use this skill

```text
arcantry skills link intake-repository-work
```

## Examples

### Capture a repository issue locally

**Prompt**

> Use $intake-repository-work to capture this requested change and its acceptance criteria in the repository's local operational format.

**Expected outcome**

A provenance-aware local issue and working note that follow existing conventions and remain outside tracked project state.

### Intake a remote review

**Prompt**

> Use $intake-repository-work to record these pull-request findings locally without replying to or changing the remote pull request.

**Expected outcome**

A new revision-scoped review artifact with exact source freshness and no unauthorized external mutation.
